senses.gloss:
€1U. (एषति-ते, एषितुम्, एषित) 
__1 To go or approach. 
__2 To hasten towards, fly at, attack any one. 
__3 To endeavour to reach or gain. 
__4 To request. 
__5 To desire. 
__6 To creep or glide; पराङ्मित्र एषतु [[Av. 6. 67. 3.]] 
__7 To know; एषितुं प्रेषितो यातो मया तस्यानुजो वनम् [[Bk. 5. 82.]]
